title: THE VISITOR
message: Something unfamiliar is entering your world.
meaning:
The Visitor is not necessarily a person. It may be a new job, an idea, a contact or a change that has already crossed the threshold.

The card asks you to notice what has arrived before it becomes familiar.
imageAlt: A completely empty room, but near the entrance there is another pair of wet footprints that begin at the closed door and lead inside. No one is there.
